rationale: This additive hosted Experience repair closes an unbounded Realtime voice presentation state without changing Runtime capability, policy, Authority, or execution semantics. A live provider response now has a ten-second terminal boundary. On timeout the WebRTC transport is closed before the already captured utterance may be submitted through the existing exact, session-scoped canonical Voice Operator action. That governed request has its own twelve-second browser boundary and retains the Gateway and Runtime fail-closed checks. Where supported, browser speech recognition provides an explicit eight-second input fallback and browser speech synthesis reads only the actual Runtime-returned response; neither browser API creates Evidence, proof, receipt, Authority, execution, or a fabricated response. Unsupported or denied browser audio remains explicit and typed governed input stays usable.
